latestVersion.changelog:
futuristic-elegance-openapi-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release: transform portraits into cinematic, futuristic Harajuku fashion scenes
- Supports image upload, style customization, and batch generation (1–16 images)
- Secure API key handling — only works with openapi.weshop.ai
